title: helianthemum marifolium

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects.
